notes.title: Bugfix Patch #1
notes.notes:
Since the release, players have reported two minor issues, which have now been resolved:

[olist]
[*] Uncatchable Cat in the Hut in level 8: This issue has been fixed. The cat located on the table was malfunctioning and has been removed from the game entirely.

[*] Achievements Not Functioning Properly: Some achievements were not unlocking for players, which might have been caused by a lack of internet connection. We’ve implemented robust measures to prevent such problems in the future. Additionally, any missing achievements should automatically be synchronized and unlocked the next time the game is launched after applying the update.
[/olist]
We are confident that these improvements will enhance your gaming experience. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you encounter any further issues.

Enjoy the game and take it easy! 🐾

notes.title: April 1st
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to remind that our game, Hidden Cat Outlaws, is launching on April 1st! Get ready to dive into an exciting adventure full of cats, and mischievous cat-bosses. We've hidden 15 ancient, super-valuable treasures across the game—one on each level—for you to uncover. But the path won't be easy! Defeat the bosses, and they’ll reward you with hint maps to track down the treasures. Each treasure also comes with its own exclusive Steam achievement, so don’t miss out!

Hidden Cat Outlaws features 15 levels, offering hours of fun and exploration. Not sure yet if you want the full version? No problem! The free demo will still be available after the full release. Try it out and see what you think!

We can’t wait to hear what you think about the final version of the game. Share your thoughts in the comments section—we’d love to know what treasures you’ve found! The countdown is on, and we’re so excited to welcome you to the world of Hidden Cat Outlaws!"

notes.title: Maps & Ancient treasures.
notes.notes:
Inspired by the incredible feedback from our demo players, we've taken things to the next level! We've hidden 15 ancient, ultra-valuable treasures—one on each level—just waiting for you to discover them. But there's a catch! To uncover these treasures, you'll need to defeat a boss. And when you conquer the crafty cat-boss, it won't just surrender—it'll hand over a hint map to guide you to the prize. Oh, and did we mention? Each treasure unlocks its own exclusive Steam achievement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859066/41e0569a195a899b1f83df6ca2e6df8105f2b824.png[/img]
We hope you will have even more fun with this improved version of HCO! Let us know how you like the final version of the game in the comments section! If you're not sure if you want to buy the full version, the free demo will still be available after the full game's release, so you can try it out.

We're sure you'll like the demo, but remember—the treasures are only available in the full-release version! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859066/847b9a90bd4ef56bc983c922feca9af43ee11c32.png[/img]
And there are 15 levels instead of just 3. ;)
